stem: A company allows employees to use their personal smartphones and tablets to access work-related information through a Bring Your Own Device (BYOD) policy. To effectively address the security challenges posed by potential loss or theft of these personal devices, which measure should the company implement as a priority?

options.text: Implementing a Mobile Device Management (MDM) solution to remotely wipe data and enforce security policies.
Providing training sessions on cybersecurity best practices and secure use of personal devices.
Ensuring all company data accessed via personal devices is backed up to a secure cloud service.
Mandating the installation of specific security applications on all personal devices used for work.
